QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] Silent Crusade
QuestInfo.0: Ask Bastille what kind of work he has to offer.
QuestInfo.1: Bastille offered you a chance to join the Silent Crusade, but only if you were able to defeat...his puppy? What in the world are these people up to?!
QuestInfo.2: You got a big surprise when Coco revealed his true form, but you managed to best him in combat and you are now a member of the Silent Crusade.

1.0: You've passed my test. I must say, it was quite a surprise and a bit of a disappointment. Muffins is very expensive to feed. Nevertheless, our organization has gained a new face, if you would be kind enough to accept my offer.

yes.0: Welcome to the Silent Crusade, my friend. We are a special branch of the Alliance, one meant to protect the people from the impending doom the Black Mage would spread across Maple World. Our current mission is to collect information regarding the Black Mage's return and the strange phenomena that appear across the land. We also handle any monsters that may threaten our cities. In short, we are the secret protectors of the land, when it suits our goals.

mob.0: You must pass this test or I cannot let you join. I will allow you to retake it as many times as you'd like, but be aware that it's not going to get any easier.
